title: Maximize Distance to Closest Person
summary: Given an array indicating seats where 1 means a person is seated and 0 means the seat is empty, find the seat where the distance to the nearest seated person is maximized.
statement: Given an array indicating seats where 1 means a person is seated and 0 means the seat is empty, find the seat where the distance to the nearest seated person is maximized. Ensure at least one seat is empty and at least one person is seated.
constraints: At least one seat is occupied and one is empty.
Choose an empty seat maximizing distance to the closest occupied seat.
hints: Edge gaps use their full length; interior gaps contribute half rounded down.
Track the previous occupied index while scanning occupied seats.
Update leading i, interior (i-last)//2, and trailing n-1-last.
The nearest occupied seat in each independent gap determines its optimal position and distance.
editorial: The nearest occupied seat in each independent gap determines its optimal position and distance.

tests.explanation: The center of the three-seat gap is distance two from either occupied end.
The trailing empty seat is distance three from the occupied seat.
